from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyIntangibleAsset(BaseModel):
    """An Intangible Assets record extracted from a single company's financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company the report belongs to")
    asset_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact label of the asset line item found (e.g. '无形资产')")
    value: str | None = Field(description="The numerical amount as reported in the document")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="The currency/unit scale of the amount (e.g. '元', '百万元')")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period this figure applies to")
    quote: str = Field(description="A verbatim excerpt from the document containing this figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    intangible_asset_records: list[CompanyIntangibleAsset]
